market_view: Stress regime: VIX jumped 13% to 20.7 after a divided Fed held rates despite high inflation and Wall Street fell sharply. Semiconductors fell hard (ETF -14% in 5 days) and oil spiked again; 10-year yield stays near 4.6%.

oil_gas.reasoning: WTI +6.6% in one day is already priced in; XOM is +14.7% in 20 days. Headlines give no new concrete catalyst, and a deal or an escalation could swing it either way. No edge.

gold_miners.reasoning: Gold is 24% below its peak and under its 200-day average, yields are high and the Fed is on hold. No catalyst for NEM beyond the already known Q2 beat; the trend flag is not a reason.

chips.reasoning: Sector ETF -14% in 5 days and a stress regime means large moves both ways. A headline mentions a chip rebound but it is unclear when; NVDA earnings call is scheduled but the date is unknown. Do not guess a rebound.

pharma.reasoning: LLY is up 25% in 60 days and near its high; defensive but no named catalyst, only earnings variance. Retatrutide news is already public.

copper_uranium.reasoning: FCX fell 7.7% in 5 days with no FCX-specific cause; copper is mixed and uranium headlines (Congo exports, BLM land exchange comment) do not reach the stock. No concrete reason.

would_change_my_mind: A concrete scheduled catalyst with a clear skew (for example an NVDA or FCX earnings result already out, an Iran deal or Hormuz news, or a soft jobs report moving yields) after the VIX calms.

handoff.what_changed: A divided Fed held rates despite high inflation and stocks fell sharply; VIX rose to 20.7. The semiconductor ETF fell 14% in 5 days, WTI jumped 6.6% in one day to 84.5, and uranium and copper miners fell. All families stay flat.

oil_gas.why: The WTI one-day spike is priced in and XOM is up 14.7% in 20 days; no durable edge.

gold_miners.why: Gold is 24% below its peak with high yields and no NEM-specific catalyst.

chips.why: Stress regime after a 14% weekly drop in the sector; do not guess a rebound, no NVDA result yet.

pharma.why: LLY is near its high after +25% in 60 days with no new named catalyst.

copper_uranium.why: FCX fell with no stock-specific cause; the uranium and Congo headlines do not reach FCX.

handoff.next_job: Next decision day: read the handoff, re-check the five families after the VIX spike, and look for concrete catalysts (NVDA, XOM, LLY and FCX earnings, the jobs report, Iran news). Stay flat unless a named reason appears.
